set.body: Install the worklog work-tracking scaffold in forge-notes: bin/ helper scripts, git hooks wired via core.hooksPath, .work/ JSONL logs with union merge, the CI workflow, and docs/plans + docs/status. Configure the repo for GitHub Issues as the ticket tracker and the GitHub wiki for docs publishing. bin/ and hooks/ are committed so hooks and CI work for teammates who do not have the plugin installed.
set.title: Scaffold worklog tracking and configure GitHub Issues + wiki

set.body: Enable Better Auth's local email and password provider and build the sign-in/sign-up form on the login route. Social sign-in federates through the shared Grok auth broker, whose preview OAuth client only accepts callbacks on *.grok-sandbox.com, so it cannot complete on a Tauri desktop window or local dev where the origin is loopback. Email and password is the only working desktop sign-in path. Also rebrands the login page to ForgeNotes and regenerates the Tauri icons.
set.title: Email & password sign-in for desktop and localhost
